title: US single release: Mull Of Kintyre by Wings | 1977
content:
Wings’ single ‘Mull Of Kintyre’ was released as a single in the United States on 14 November 1977, three days after its UK release.

A double a-side with ‘Girls School’, it was Wings’ most successful single in the UK, selling more than 2.5 million copies and spending nine weeks at the top of the singles chart.

In the US, ‘Girls School’ was given greater prominence than ‘Mull Of Kintyre’. However, the single fared far less well, with ‘Girls School’ peaking at number 11 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The Scottish theme of ‘Mull Of Kintyre’ connected less well across the Atlantic, and Paul McCartney became concerned that Capitol were not willing or able to adequately promote his work with Wings. The single also went no higher than number 34 in Canada.

It’s a double a-side. The other one, ‘Girls School’, I wrote after reading the back pages of X films, y’know the page? It’s all titles like School Mistress and The Woman Trainer. I just put them all together in the lyrics and called it ‘Girls School’. It’s about a pornographic St Trinians. We made it a double a-side because the b-sides always get swallowed. You never hear them. At least ‘Girls School’ will get played a bit.
Paul McCartney
Page last updated: 5 February 2026
